title: PFM Product Index
description: Publications and Forms Manager (PFM) product index (PI) of all applicable organizational publications and forms that the PFM maintains (Department of the Air Force Manual (DAFMAN) 90-161, 6.4.2).

fields.ref: DAFMAN 90-161 4.5.11.1.2 (prescribed forms; the prescribing publication), 7.4.2 (OPRs review publications and associated prescribed forms together). Set on form rows only; the app shows each publication's Prescribed Forms from it (PFM 2026-11-11)

Inactive = past the four-year periodic review without certify-as-current (DAFMAN 90-161 7.4.2; PFM 2026-11-11, the PFM's existing practice). Superseded and Rescinded trigger AFRIMS RDS T 33-38 R 07 for the record set (DAF Forms 673 and 399 and accompanying documentation); the publication and its index entry stay browsable. Expired = a guidance memorandum past its 1-year life (DAFMAN glossary "obsolete": rescinded, superseded or expired; 7.9.3); PFM 2026-11-11 (r7, design check decision 1A)
Date Product Status last changed (Superseded, Rescinded or Inactive); T 33-38 R 07 trigger date for the record set
